text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No... I just had this weird dream, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
This freakin' huge piece of candy came out.
No matter how much I lick it, it doesn't get any smaller.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I tried to lick it clean out of sheer spite,
but my tongue got tired...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer.
There's nothing wrong with my taste buds, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Jungle Pocket couldn't rest well because of a strange dream.
